text:
Priya: quick check — need to scale a hybrid pool in apac for a partner demo next week, target: H100-backed canary of 4 nodes (short-lived). can we confirm available quota & whether vendor can hold for a 24h window?
Evan: @Priya which region exactly? we have different spot behavior in ap-northeast vs ap-southeast.
Priya: ap-northeast1 ideally. demo traffic is low but latency-sensitive. will be using our private AMI (ami-redwood-2026-03) — can infra please ensure AMI has billing tags and the right kernel for h100?
Sophie: tagging + kernel looks fine on master AMI, but we need the build that includes the driver 55.x kernel module. i pushed a small job to bake an AMI variant: ami-redwood-2026-03-h100. link: https://ci.internal/4234 (copy).
Alex: i can reserve a short burst capacity in the dedicated pool if procurement OKs the vendor hold. current spare H100 inventory in ap-northeast shows 2 available preemptible and 1 spare reserved. not enough for 4-nodes canary unless we do a mix (2 H100 + 2 A500 fallback).
Priya: fallback to A500 is acceptable if perf degrades gracefully. can we set an autoscale policy that prefers H100 but falls back to A500?
Evan: yes — autoscale policy exist. config snippet: 
```
preferred_instance_types: [h100, a500]
fallback_policy: sequential
max_unstable: 1
```
we'll need a quick PR to the pool config.
Sophie: procurement update — vendor said they can hold a 24h window starting 2026-07-14 if we confirm by EOD Mon. they require a small deposit. raising SOW now.
Priya: can someone check quota for h100 in ap-northeast1 for the org-level project? i think we're near the committed capacity for dedicated but not all assigned to pools.
Alex: checking now, running: `gcloud compute regions describe ap-northeast1 --project=redwood-prod` — current quota for A100/H100 combined is 12 GPUs, used 10 across dedicated + reserved. meaning we can likely free 2 by shifting ephemeral workloads.
Evan: oncall note: if we shift ephemeral workloads, watch the CI GPU queue — i will temporarily throttle non-critical CI runs between 03:00–07:00 UTC if that helps.
Priya: thanks. Sophie — can procurement confirm deposit amount? i want to approve quickly.
Sophie: deposit is small (~$1.2k) for the 24h hold. i'll start the approval flow.
Alex: small ops thing — AMI needs the kernel boot arg `no_kaslr` for the H100 driver to avoid a boot race on some host firmware. i'll add that to the AMI build job.
Priya: pinging @Alex for a quick PR review on the pool config — PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infrastructure/pulls/892 — it's tiny (2 lines): preferred types + tag.
Alex: lgtm, left one nit about a comment.
DeployBot: terraform plan completed for `hybrid-canary-apac`: no changes to live pools, pending PR merge will update the autoscale policy.
Evan: timeline idea — if procurement confirms today and we merge PR tonight, i can schedule the burst for 2026-07-14 01:00 UTC and rollback window at 09:00 UTC.
Priya: sounds good. last ask: can someone add a short runbook step for fallback verification (latency smoke + perf degrade alert thresholds)? i can draft and post.
Alex: i'll add an alert: `canary.latency.h100_vs_a500` comparing p95; will trigger if delta > 40% for 3m.
Sophie: procurement done, deposit sent. will update legal onboarding channel.
Priya: thanks all — i'll mark this as proceeding. will post post-mortem if any hiccups. :thumbsup:
Evan: noted — handing off to oncall for the night window. good luck!
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: hybrid-canary-apac on 2026-07-14T01:00:00Z by Priya.
